edges: Theseus discusses the inevitability of death and the importance of dying with a good name.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Emily prays to Diana to marry the one who doesn't love her.
Theseus captures Palamon and Arcite after defeating Creon in battle.
Palamon falls in love with Emily after seeing her in the courtyard.
Palamon prays to Venus to make Emily his wife.
Arcite prays to Mars for victory in the tournament.
